notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only dated claim (1968) comes from a personal GitHub note that cites nothing. The Forest Lookouts page gives only name and county. The FFLA row's register cell is blank; the FFLOS number printed above the Bidwell text in the cached page belongs to Berryessa Peak, so no register is claimed. The peakbagging table lists no national forest for this site. The same note is tagged 'destroyed' with no date; not used in the story. Worth a second look in Glenn County or Mendocino NF records if someone can reach them.
